rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a strong, unequivocal assertion.

example.english: We unequivocally cannot delay this matter any longer.
example.traditional: 呢件事絕對唔可以再拖。
example.jyutping: ne1 gin6 si6 zyut6 deoi3 m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 to1

rows.note: Use this when stressing that there is no room for doubt, especially in more formal wording.

example.english: The report proves unequivocally that this plan is the safest.
example.traditional: 份報告證明，呢個方案毫無疑問係最穩陣。
example.jyutping: fan2 bou3 gou3 zing3 ming4 ni1 go3 fong1 on3 hou4 mou4 ji4 man6 hai6 zeoi3 wan2 zan6

rows.note: Use this when describing someone stating or deciding something firmly and categorically.

example.english: They stated unequivocally that they would not change their position.
example.traditional: 佢斬釘截鐵咁話自己唔會改口。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zaam2 deng1 zit6 tit3 gam3 waa6 zi6 gei2 m4 wui5 goi2 hau2
